raw.rationale: BMS-299897 is a gamma-secretase inhibitor with no known broad cytotoxic mechanism, and gamma-secretase inhibition is not expected to produce lineage-selective killing in a 5-day PRISM viability assay; any apparent selectivity would likely reflect assay noise or rare context-specific effects. Thus probabilities are low across all lineages, with slight elevation only for lineages where Notch/gamma-secretase signaling is more prominent (e.g., CNS, breast, colorectal).
